prompt.description: Minimal hate-speech question plus one compact rule distilled from the GHC paper: group-based attacks or calls for violence count as hate; offensive language alone does not. Tests whether a single precision-nudging note beats both the vague minimal prompt and the long Detailed GHC definition.
